old_text: Organizations must delete customer data within 30 days of receiving a verified deletion request.
new_text: Organizations must delete customer data within 3 days of receiving a verified deletion request.
description: Critical deadline tightening from 30 days to 3 days

old_text: This policy applies to full-time employees located in the primary office.
new_text: This policy applies to all full-time, part-time, and contractor personnel across all substantive regional entities.
description: Substantive scope expansion to new personnel and entities

old_text: Data protection officers must report directly to executive management.
new_text: Data protection officers must report directly to executive management.
description: Exact text match across regulation versions

old_text: Violations may incur fines up to 10,000 EUR per non-compliant instance.
new_text: Violations may incur substantive fines up to 500,000 EUR per non-compliant instance.

old_text: Prior to processing personal data, the controller must identify a valid legal basis under Article 6.
new_text: Before processing personal data, the controller must identify a valid legal basis under Article 6.
description: Subtle wording synonym change (Prior to -> Before) without changing legal meaning

old_text: The processor must implement appropriate technical and organisational safeguards to secure personal data.
new_text: The data processor shall maintain suitable technical and organisational safeguards to secure personal data.
description: Synonym swap (must implement -> shall maintain; appropriate -> suitable)

old_text: The controller should inform data subjects without delay and within 14 days of confirming an unencrypted breach.
new_text: The controller must notify affected data subjects immediately and in all circumstances within 48 hours of confirming an unencrypted breach.
description: Multiple simultaneous changes: modal shift (should -> must) and deadline reduction (14 days -> 48 hours)

old_text: Taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, the controller shall implement appropriate data protection policies.
new_text: Having regard to the nature, scope, context and objectives of data processing, the data controller shall establish suitable data protection policies.
description: Multiple simultaneous stylistic edits across introductory clauses without altering obligations

old_text: The controller shall provide a copy of the personal data undergoing processing within 1 month of receipt of the request.
new_text: The controller shall provide a copy of the personal data undergoing processing within 30 calendar days of receipt of the request.
description: Ambiguous timeframe equivalent format (1 month vs 30 calendar days)

old_text: Security incident preliminary reports must be submitted to the supervisory desk within 48 hours.
new_text: Security incident preliminary reports must be submitted to the supervisory desk within 2 days.
description: Time unit conversion (48 hours to 2 days) without changing the deadline window

old_text: All covered business entities operating customer-facing digital web applications and mobile software services shall maintain comprehensive cryptographic audit logging for all database transactions and administrative access events across all production runtime clusters.
new_text: All covered business entities operating customer-facing digital web applications and mobile software services shall maintain comprehensive cryptographic audit logging for all database transactions and administrative access events across all production runtime clusters, except for micro-enterprises processing fewer than 5,000 records annually.
description: Exemption buried at the end of a dense paragraph creating a significant scope carveout

old_text: Data transfer mechanisms involving third-party cloud hosting providers located outside the European Economic Area must incorporate standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission, along with supplementary technical safeguards including end-to-end encryption.
new_text: Data transfer mechanisms involving third-party cloud hosting vendors located outside the European Economic Area must incorporate standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission, along with supplementary technical safeguards including robust end-to-end encryption.
description: Minor adjective and noun variation (providers -> vendors; added 'robust') in a long paragraph

old_text: The obligations referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply to an enterprise employing fewer than 250 persons.
new_text: The obligations referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply to an enterprise employing fewer than 50 persons.
description: Employee threshold lowered from 250 to 50 persons significantly expanding compliance reach

old_text: Financial institutions must report any cybersecurity loss event exceeding a threshold of $50,000 to the central banking authority.
new_text: Financial institutions must report any cybersecurity loss event exceeding a threshold of $50,000 USD to the central banking authority.
description: Clarifying currency suffix ($50,000 to $50,000 USD) without altering numerical threshold
